notes.title: Playtest Update: Combat System & Dynamic Weather
notes.content:
In this update, we've introduced a powerful new combat feature where players can control a low orbit satellite armed with a cutting-edge cannon. This satellite is the colony’s primary defense against the ancient remnant technology on Titan, known as Sentinels. These Sentinels are relentless in their mission to eliminate any life or technology on Titan, making every building you construct vulnerable to their attacks.

A new feature has also been added to the combat system: the Cam Projectile. Players can now follow every projectile fired by the satellite in real-time, offering a thrilling, close-up view of the destruction as it unfolds.

Additionally, we've implemented a dynamic weather system, immersing players in Titan’s harsh and unpredictable environment, featuring dust storms, fierce winds, and lightning strikes.

Performance improvements have also been made, enhancing the functionality of robots and buildings across the map. We've introduced new pathways to allow smoother movement for both robots and drones. This update not only boosts the gameplay experience but also adds new layers of strategy and survival on Titan.

notes.title: Playtest Update: New Features
notes.content:
We're excited to announce our latest playtest update, brimming with new features, content, and improvements. Here’s what you can expect:

New Flying Bot: We’ve added a new flying bot that collects resources efficiently. Enjoy its brand-new animations that bring more life and dynamism to your gameplay experience.
  
Expanded Map Access: You can now explore the northern region of Titan. This area is rich in ice deposits that you can excavate to collect water, which is crucial for your mission to send resources back to Earth.

Game Over Feature: A new game over feature has been implemented to add a challenging endpoint to your missions, making your decisions more impactful.

Save and Load Functionality: We've introduced the ability to save your game progress and load it at your convenience, allowing for a more flexible and player-friendly experience.

New Ice Ore Resource: In the northern region, you will find new ice ore deposits. These can be mined and processed to extract water, adding a new layer of resource management.

Local Rocket System: We’ve added a new local rocket that facilitates the transfer of water from the northern region to the Yellow Lagoon, integrating new strategic elements into resource logistics.

Performance Enhancements: Experience smoother gameplay with our latest performance improvements. We’ve also upgraded the texture resolution of the HUD for a clearer and more visually appealing interface.

New Technology and Minor Objectives: Unlock new technologies and tackle minor objectives. Completing these objectives will earn you rewards, adding more depth and incentives to gameplay.

Improved Trade System: The trade system has been refined for better usability and balance, enhancing your strategic trade decisions.

Enhanced Game Intro: We’ve revamped the game introduction to provide a more engaging and informative start to your adventure.

Spanish Language Support: The game is now fully localized in Spanish, making it accessible to a broader audience.

Decorative Corporation Flag: Customize your base by building a corporation flag, adding a personal touch to your in-game environment.

Improved Building Info Textures: Building information textures have been enhanced for better clarity and detail, aiding in efficient base management.

Camera Movement and Zoom Improvements: We’ve refined camera controls for smoother movement and zoom, giving you better control over your view of the game world.

Detailed Tips and Guidance: To help you get started and progress, we’ve added detailed tips and guidance both at the beginning and throughout the game, ensuring you’re never lost on what to do next.

We believe these updates will significantly enhance your gaming experience. Dive in, explore the new features, and let us know your thoughts!
